name: Vanessa Huckaby

bio.statement: Huckaby's pamphlet statement lists service as Gladstone city councilor, including council president in 2022-2023 and from 2025.

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Huckaby lists downtown revitalization and welcoming new businesses to the Town Center.
positions.excerpt: Downtown revitalization, welcoming new businesses, and attracting neighbors and visitors to our Town Center

positions.statement: Huckaby's pamphlet statement supports safer streets through more controlled intersections, clearer markings and redesigns.
positions.excerpt: Making our streets safer by adding more controlled intersections, clearer markings, and thoughtful redesigns

positions.statement: Huckaby's pamphlet statement says she wants to keep the community on a positive path.
positions.excerpt: I want to keep our community on a positive path.

gaps: No campaign website (pamphlet lists only an Instagram account)
